title: Phase 2：證明 OEIS A268754 的奇數項公式 a(2n+1) = 2a(n)（n ≠ 2^k − 1）與死亡條件

A268754-odd.proof: Lean (core only) for every n >= 1: a268754_odd (n+1 not a power of 2: least eventual period doubles) and a268754_odd_exception (n+1 = 2^k: both die, period 1); dies_iff (wire dies iff n+1 = 2^k). Numeric check by two implementations for n <= 40 and against the 54 DATA terms.

novelty.note: The FORMULA and the death COMMENT of A268754 are stated without proof or reference. The argument (spreading onto odd cells, parity, invertibility for even widths) uses standard techniques; MOW 1984's doubling of the maximal ring period is the same idea for a different quantity. Not checked: arXiv, MathSciNet, Math Fun, the Stack Exchange chat logs linked from the entry. PROVEN_KNOWN means proven with known techniques, not claimed new.
